notes: JICA DFR (2018-ish) design: FTI is an at-grade side-station-beside-tracks stop (Type E', island/side single platform between 2 tracks) within the FTI complex near East Service Rd & Champaca Rd; ground-plan chainage KP9+200-9+600. NOTE: as-built NSCR (CP NSCR-03-B, Leighton-First Balfour, 2023-2025) later changed FTI to an underground cut-and-cover station with MMSP interchange, so DFR geometry is superseded. Position: primary anchor is the printed Google Earth coordinate on Fig 4.4.9 (14.504494,121.036389); Mapcarta lists old FTI PNR station at (14.5064,121.03556), 230 m away -> uncertainty 250 m. Geodesic azimuth Bicutan->FTI is -28.0 deg, consistent with the -28.3 deg line azimuth used for the PRS92 offset. Footprint length 140 m is an estimate (station length not dimensioned in the DFR figures); width 25 m is the Type E' standard width. Cross-check: PRS92 back-transform reproduces the WGS84 estimate within ~12 m.
